_doc: Full-config (non-smoke) reference for orchestrators that want a longer run. The smoke entrypoint already ships at full-config sizes (CEO instruction — no SMOKE_DEFAULTS regression); this file only changes the epoch budget and exposes the Poisson-only loss-weight knob as a one-flag ablation.

_poisson_loss_knob._doc: Optional ablation: apply HF_weight=2 / LF_weight=0.25 (Poisson-only, niu2024mfrnp Poisson5 recipe). Off by default in the smoke harness; orchestrator must opt in by overriding hf_loss_weight and lf_loss_weights when running ifc_poisson.
